summary: The team is juggling multiple high-priority initiatives including the China Going-Global report, Asia Star and Intelligent China program marketing, and the knowledge website redesign, with urgent deadlines this week for report distribution and SEM campaign summaries.
summaryDetail: The most urgent matters this week are finalizing and distributing the China Going-Global report to Professor Li Wei and compiling the Intelligent China SEM campaign summary for internal stakeholders. In parallel, the knowledge website redesign is moving forward with a decision to remove the videos panel and integrate videos into topic sections, while awaiting feedback on Joseph's design and incorporating indices into the homepage. For program marketing, Asia Star and Intelligent China remain top priorities, with SEO and conversion tracking efforts underway, while US partnerships are deferred. Additionally, there are housekeeping items like resolving Outlook login issues and promoting the July Business Conditions Index on social media.

decisions.text: Remove the videos panel from the knowledge website homepage.
Videos will be integrated into topic-based sections rather than having their own category.
The knowledge website will feature a school menu at the top and a knowledge menu, with the knowledge menu centered.

Defer US partnership programs (Stanford, Columbia) for now, but consider Berkeley as a third priority.
Delete the previous chapter 2 from the China Going Global report.
